title: Birds
examples: How do birds fly so high in the sky?
What do birds need to build their nests?
Do all birds migrate every year?

explain.say: Look at these feathers. Feathers help birds fly and keep them warm.
Birds also have hollow bones. This helps them to be light enough for flying.
Birds lay eggs to have babies. The eggs keep the young safe until they hatch.
Flight is when birds use their wings to move through the air. They flap their wings to fly.
Migration means birds travel long distances between places. They move to warmer areas in winter.
Think about a bird building a nest. They use twigs and soft grass to make a safe home.

faq.a: No, some birds cannot fly. Penguins and ostriches are good examples of this.
Birds migrate to find food or warmer weather when their home area gets too cold.
asks: Why do birds travel so far?

faq.a: Hollow bones are lighter than solid bones of the same size. This helps birds fly better.
asks: Do bones get lighter when hollow?

faq.q: What is the purpose of feathers?
faq.a: Feathers help birds fly, but they also act like an insulating layer to keep them warm.
asks: What do feathers do for birds?

faq.a: Female birds lay eggs, and these eggs contain everything the baby bird needs to start life.
asks: What is inside a bird egg?

facts: Feathers provide both warmth and lift for birds.
Hollow bones make the bird's skeleton very light.
Birds lay eggs that protect the developing chicks.
Migration is the seasonal movement of birds.

quiz.say: Which feature helps a bird fly more easily?
quiz.why: Hollow bones are lighter than solid bones, which helps the bird fly with less effort.

wrong.0: Strong muscles are needed, but the bones must also be light enough.
wrong.2: Thick feathers are good for warmth but add too much weight for easy flight.
wrong.3: Large eggs are for laying, not for helping the bird fly.

quiz.say: When birds travel to warmer places in winter, this journey is called:
quiz.why: Migration is the specific term for birds traveling long distances between seasons.

wrong.0: Nesting is when they build a home, not when they travel.
wrong.1: Hatching is when the baby bird leaves the egg.
wrong.3: Flying is the action, but migration is the reason for the long journey.

quiz.say: If a bird needs to be light for flight, which body part is most helpful?
quiz.why: Hollow bones reduce the bird's weight without losing too much strength.

wrong.0: A big body usually means more weight, making flight harder.
wrong.2: Large wings are good, but if the bones are heavy, the wings will struggle.
wrong.3: While feathers are important, the bone structure must also be light.
